t: An open-source robot dog you build yourself from a free parts list.
steps: Choose a path. Order parts from the official parts list, or buy a kit from Present Perfection or AIFitLab.
Order the two custom circuit boards fully assembled from JLCPCB, following the sourcing guide.
Follow the build guide to print parts, set heat-set inserts, and assemble the legs.
Flash the control board firmware with STM32CubeProgrammer and an ST-Link adapter.
Write the pupOS image to a USB drive with Raspberry Pi Imager 1.8.5.
Boot the robot and run the walking demo from the docs.
Start the Pupper course and try the first motor control lab.
Ask questions in the Hands-On Robotics Discord.
meta: Open Board. From $3,400. A few stores.
